Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Leiden, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders at home. At the start of your shift, you prepare for the route ahead. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel of the delivery van and head towards your first customer. At each stop, you select the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You greet the customer, hand over the groceries and provide friendly service. If there are empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to the next address. This is not a job where you spend your entire shift sitting behind the wheel. Throughout the day, you regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' homes and lift grocery crates. Driving, physical activity and customer contact are all part of the position. You complete your route independently, which means you are responsible for driving safely and handling the orders carefully. After your final delivery, you return to the location and complete your shift. Can I apply without delivery experience? Yes. Previous experience as a delivery driver, courier or professional driver is not required. During your first working days, you can join an experienced colleague. This gives you the opportunity to learn the delivery process and become familiar with the job before completing routesindependently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I need to work every Saturday? No. However, you must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is this a physically active job? Yes. In addition to driving, you will regularly carry grocery crates from the van to customers' doors. You will also be getting in and out of the vehicle throughout your route, so you need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You can work independently and responsibly. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Would you like to combine driving with an active and varied job in Leiden? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online.
